newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Steyr H1 earnings swing into black.
newsitem.headline: Steyr H1 earnings swing into black.

text.p: Steyr-Daimler-Puch AG, Austria's maker of specialist vehicles and components, said on Monday group pre-tax profit climbed to 107 million schillings in the first half from a loss of 69 million in the year-ago period.
Sales jumped 20 percent to 6.5 billion schillings and Steyr said it expected earnings to improve in the full year.
